                        holdInput = input
                                prevScroll = TabPage.ScrollingEnabled
                                TabPage.ScrollingEnabled = false -- que la página no se mueva mientras lo arrastran
                                ctl.Grab()
                                local p = unproject(screenOf(input))
                                if p then ctl.MoveTo(p) end
                            end
                        end)
                        track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                            if not holdInput then return end
                            local mouseDrag = holdInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                            if input == holdInput or mouseDrag then
                                local p = unproject(screenOf(input))
                                if p then ctl.MoveTo(p) end
                            end
                        end))
                        track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                            if not holdInput then return end
                            if input == holdInput or (holdInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
                                holdInput = nil
                                TabPage.ScrollingEnabled = prevScroll
                                ctl.Release()
                            end
                        end))
                    end

                    -- Owner (mousoza) sentado en el piso, al fondo y a un costado, mirando de un lado a otro
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local okId, ownerId = pcall(function()
                            return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync("mousoza")
                        end)
                        if not okId or type(ownerId) ~= "number" then return end
                        local okM, owner = pcall(function()
                            return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromUserId(ownerId)
                        end)
                        if not okM or not owner or not World.Parent then return end
                        owner.Name = "HomeOwnerModel"
                        cleanModel(owner)
                        owner.Parent = World
                        local oRoot = owner:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or owner:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or owner:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                        if oRoot and owner.PrimaryPart == nil then
                            pcall(function() owner.PrimaryPart = oRoot end)
                        end
                        pcall(function()
                            local H = (okBox and size) and size.Y or 5
                            local floorY = (okBox and cf) and (cf.Position.Y - size.Y / 2) or -2.5
                            owner:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
                            local oCf, oSize = owner:GetBoundingBox()
                            local feetFromPivot = oCf.Position.Y - oSize.Y / 2
                            local z = -H * 1.8
                            local shadow = Instance.new("Part")
                            shadow.Name = "OwnerShadow"
                            shadow.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
                            shadow.Anchored = true
                            shadow.CanCollide = false
                            shadow.CastShadow = false
                            shadow.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                            shadow.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
                            shadow.Transparency = 0.62
                            shadow.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, H * 0.85, H * 0.85)
                            shadow.Parent = World
                            -- Ubicación según el ancho REAL de la vista: el centro del owner queda al 38% del medio
                            -- hacia la derecha, así no se sale del hueco entre las tarjetas (en celular la vista es
                            -- más ancha que ese hueco). Se recalcula si la ventana cambia de tamaño.
                            HomeAnim.OwnerEnv = { model = owner, shadow = shadow, floorY = floorY, H = H, standY = floorY - feetFromPivot }
                            local function placeOwner()
                                local abs = Viewport.AbsoluteSize
                                local aspect = (abs.X > 0 and abs.Y > 0) and (abs.X / abs.Y) or 0.7
                                local camPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
                                local fov = (tonumber(Camera.FieldOfView) or 70)
                                local d = camPos.Z - z
                                local x = camPos.X + 0.38 * d * math.tan(math.rad(fov / 2)) * aspect
                                local pos = Vector3.new(x, floorY - feetFromPivot, z)
                                -- mira hacia la cámara
                                local place = CFrame.new(pos, Vector3.new(camPos.X, pos.Y, camPos.Z))
                                HomeAnim.OwnerEnv.home = place
                                if HomeAnim.OwnerCtl then
                                    HomeAnim.OwnerCtl.SetHome(place) -- si lo están moviendo, solo cambia a dónde vuelve
                                    return
                                end
                                owner:PivotTo(place)
                                -- sombra en el piso (un disco oscuro), corrida hacia donde quedan las piernas
                                local legsAhead = place.LookVector * (H * 0.18)
                                shadow.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(x + legsAhead.X, floorY + 0.03, z + legsAhead.Z)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
                            end
                            placeOwner()
                            track(Viewport:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
                                if owner.Parent then pcall(placeOwner) end
                            end))
                        end)
                        local okRig, rig = pcall(HomeAnim.Rig, owner)
                        if okRig and rig and rig.count >= 4 then
                            local env = HomeAnim.OwnerEnv
                            local ctl = HomeAnim.Owner(rig, env and env.home and env or nil)
                            HomeAnim.OwnerCtl = ctl
                            ctl.Step(0)
                            startAnimLoop()
                            if env and env.home then
                                pcall(HomeAnim.SetupOwnerGrab, ctl, env)
                            end
                        end
                    end)

                    task.defer(function()
                        -- animación propia; si el modelo no tiene las articulaciones, queda el idle de Roblox de antes
                        local okRig, rig = pcall(HomeAnim.Rig, model)
                        if okRig and rig and rig.count >= 4 then
                            HomeAnim.PlayerCtl = HomeAnim.Player(rig)
                            startAnimLoop()
                            return
                        end
                        pcall(function()
                            local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            if not humanoid then return end
                            local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                            if not animator then
                                animator = Instance.new("Animator")
                                animator.Parent = humanoid
                            end
                            local animIds = {
                                "rbxassetid://616010382",
                                "rbxassetid://507766388",
                                "rbxassetid://180435571",
                            }
                            local loaded = false
                            for _, animId in ipairs(animIds) do
                                if loaded then break end
                                local ok, result = pcall(function()
                                    local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
                                    anim.AnimationId = animId
                                    local track = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
                                    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
                                    track.Looped = true
                                    track:Play()
                                    loaded = true
                                end)
                                if not ok then
                                    warn("[YinYang Home] Animación no cargó: " .. animId .. " | " .. tostring(result))
                                end
                            end
                        end)
                    end)
                else
                    local fallback = mk("TextLabel", {
                        Parent = ViewportWrap,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Text = GetText("Cargando avatar...", "Loading avatar..."),
                        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                        TextSize = 14,
                        TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                        ZIndex = 12,
                    })
                    fallback:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
                end

                if model then
                    local Spin = mk("TextButton", {
                        Parent = ViewportWrap,
                        Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0.75, 0),
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.2, 0),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Text = "",
                        AutoButtonColor = false,
                        ZIndex = 12,
                    })
                    local spinInput, spinLastX, spinAngle = nil, nil, 0
                    local spinMoved = 0
                    Spin.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                            if HomeAnim.OwnerHit and HomeAnim.OwnerHit(input.Position) then return end -- es el owner
                            spinInput, spinLastX = input, input.Position.X
                            spinMoved = 0
                        end
                    end)
                    track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                        if not spinInput or not spinLastX then return end
                        if input ~= spinInput and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
                        local dx = input.Position.X - spinLastX
                        spinLastX = input.Position.X
                        spinMoved += math.abs(dx)
                        if dx ~= 0 and model.Parent then
                            spinAngle = spinAngle + dx * 0.012
                            pcall(function()
                                model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180) + spinAngle, 0))
                            end)
                        end
                    end))
                    track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                        if spinInput and (input == spinInput or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
                            spinInput, spinLastX = nil, nil
                            -- un toque (sin arrastrar) hace que tu personaje salude
                            if spinMoved < 6 and HomeAnim.PlayerCtl then
                                HomeAnim.PlayerCtl.Trigger("wave")
                            end
                        end
                    end))
                end

                return ViewportWrap
            end

            local function shorten(text)
                text = tostring(text or "")
                if #text <= 14 then
                    return text
                end
                return text:sub(1, 10) .. "..."
            end

            local hourNow = tonumber(os.date("%H")) or 12
            local greetES = (hourNow >= 5 and hourNow < 12) and "Buenos días," or ((hourNow >= 12 and hourNow < 20) and "Buenas tardes," or "Buenas noches,")
            local greetEN = (hourNow >= 5 and hourNow < 12) and "Good morning," or ((hourNow >= 12 and hourNow < 20) and "Good afternoon," or "Good evening,")
            local NameLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = HomeRoot,
                Size = UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 0, 24),
                Position = UDim2.new(0.31, 0, 0, 12),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = GetText(greetES, greetEN),
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 13,
                TextColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                ZIndex = 11,
            })
            NameLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
            NameLabel:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", greetES)
            NameLabel:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", greetEN)

            local UserLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = HomeRoot,
                Size = UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 0, 30),
                Position = UDim2.new(0.31, 0, 0, 34),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = LocalPlayer.DisplayName or LocalPlayer.Name,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 24,
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 11,
            })
            UserLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
            UserLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            UserLabel.TextSize = 26

            local Handle = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = HomeRoot,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 20),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 66),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.86,
                Text = "@" .. tostring(LocalPlayer.Name),
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 11,
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                ZIndex = 13,
            })
            Handle:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
            Handle:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
            corner(Handle, 999)
            mk("UIPadding", {Parent = Handle, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)})

            createViewport(HomeRoot)

            local cardH = 92
            local row1 = 4
            local row2 = 100
            local row3 = 196
            local leftColX = 0.03
            local rightColX = 0.71
            local cardW = 0.26

            local _, playersVal, playersSub = makeStatCard(HomeRoot, leftColX, row1, cardW, cardH, 90955646581059, "Jugadores", "Players", "1", "Conectado", "Connected")
            local pingCard, pingVal, pingSub = makeStatCard(HomeRoot, leftColX, row2, cardW, cardH, 80031485123484, "Ping", "Ping", "0 ms", "Estado de red", "Network state")
            local _, idVal = makeStatCard(HomeRoot, leftColX, row3, cardW, cardH, 126144525731859, "ID del servidor", "Server ID", "N/A", "Tocar para copiar", "Tap to copy")

            local _, timeVal = makeStatCard(HomeRoot, rightColX, row1, cardW, cardH, 128054256171328, "Tiempo", "Time", "00:00:00", "Servidor en vivo", "Server live")
            local _, regionVal = makeStatCard(HomeRoot, rightColX, row2, cardW, cardH, 84609306530754, "Región", "Region", "ES-ES", "Detectado automáticamente", "Automatically detected")
            local _, statusVal, statusSub, statusDot = makeStatCard(HomeRoot, rightColX, row3, cardW, cardH, 88363727246005, "Estado", "Status", "Healthy", "Todo funcionando", "All systems operational")

            for _, dynamic in ipairs({playersSub, pingSub, statusSub}) do
                dynamic:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", nil)
                dynamic:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", nil)
            end
            statusDot.Visible = true
            statusSub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 1, -26)
            statusSub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 24)
            local statusHalo = mk("UIStroke", {Parent = statusDot, Color = statusDot.BackgroundColor3, Thickness = 0, Transparency = 0.2})
            pcall(function()
                TweenService:Create(statusHalo, TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, -1, false, 0.4), {Thickness = 4, Transparency = 1}):Play()
            end)

            local pingBars = {}
            local BarsHolder = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = pingCard,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 16),
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 48),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ZIndex = 11,
            })
            for b = 1, 4 do
                local bar = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = BarsHolder,
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, b / 4, 0),
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, (b - 1) * 6, 1, 0),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex = 11,
                })
                corner(bar, 2)
                pingBars[b] = bar
            end

            idVal.Text = shorten((game.JobId ~= "" and game.JobId) or "N/A (Studio)")

            local copyButton = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = HomeRoot,
                Size = UDim2.new(cardW, 0, 0, cardH),
                Position = UDim2.new(leftColX, 0, 0, row3),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                ZIndex = 12,
            })
            copyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                local snippet = string.format(
                    'game:GetService("TeleportService"):TeleportToPlaceInstance(%d, "%s", game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer)',
                    game.PlaceId, game.JobId
                )
                local ok = pcall(function() setclipboard(snippet) end)
                if ok then
                    idVal.Text = GetText("¡Copiado!", "Copied!")
                end
                task.delay(1.8, function()
                    if idVal and idVal.Parent then
                        idVal.Text = shorten((game.JobId ~= "" and game.JobId) or "N/A (Studio)")
                    end
                end)
            end)

            local startClock = os.clock()
            local StatsService = game:GetService("Stats")
            local localizationService = game:GetService("LocalizationService")
            local cachedRegion = "ES-ES"
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function()
                    local region = localizationService:GetCountryRegionForPlayerAsync(LocalPlayer)
                    if type(region) == "string" and region ~= "" then
                        cachedRegion = region
                    end
                end)
            end)

            local GOOD = Color3.fromRGB(46, 213, 115)
            local WARN = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 0)
            local BAD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 82, 82)
            local frames = 0
            local frameConn = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                frames = frames + 1
            end))

            local function refreshHome(fps)
                playersVal.Text = tostring(#Players:GetPlayers()) .. " / " .. tostring(Players.MaxPlayers)
                playersSub.Text = GetText("Conectados en el servidor", "Connected in this server")
                local okPing, ping = pcall(function()
                    return StatsService.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
                end)
                ping = (okPing and tonumber(ping)) and math.floor(ping) or nil
                local level = not ping and 0 or (ping < 90 and 4 or (ping < 160 and 3 or (ping < 260 and 2 or 1)))
                local color = level >= 4 and GOOD or (level >= 3 and WARN or (level >= 1 and BAD or Theme.TextDim))
                pingVal.Text = ping and (ping .. " ms") or "N/A"
                pingVal.TextColor3 = ping and color or Theme.Text
                pingSub.Text = not ping and GetText("Sin datos", "No data")
                    or (level >= 4 and GetText("Conexión excelente", "Excellent connection")
                    or (level >= 3 and GetText("Conexión buena", "Good connection")
                    or GetText("Conexión inestable", "Unstable connection")))
                for b, bar in ipairs(pingBars) do
                    bar.BackgroundColor3 = b <= level and color or Theme.TextDim
                    bar.BackgroundTransparency = b <= level and 0 or 0.7
                end
                timeVal.Text = formatDuration(os.clock() - startClock)
                regionVal.Text = cachedRegion
                local healthy = fps >= 40 and (not ping or ping < 200)
                local okay = fps >= 25 and (not ping or ping < 350)
                statusVal.Text = healthy and GetText("Excelente", "Excellent") or (okay and GetText("Estable", "Stable") or GetText("Con lag", "Laggy"))
                statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = healthy and GOOD or (okay and WARN or BAD)
                statusHalo.Color = statusDot.BackgroundColor3
                statusSub.Text = tostring(fps) .. " FPS"
            end

            task.spawn(function()
                local last = os.clock()
                refreshHome(60)
                while HomeRoot.Parent do
                    task.wait(1)
                    local now = os.clock()
                    local fps = math.floor(frames / math.max(now - last, 0.001) + 0.5)
                    frames = 0
                    last = now
                    if TabPage.Visible then
                        pcall(refreshHome, fps)
                    end
                end
                pcall(function() frameConn:Disconnect() end)
            end)

            resetScrollTop(TabPage)
            return HomeRoot
        end

        function Tab:CreateServerInfoCard()
            if self._homeBuilt then
                return nil
            end
            local Card = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = TabPage,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                ZIndex = 9
            })
            mk("UIListLayout", {Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, Card)

            local ServerLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = Card,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = GetText("Servidor", "Server"),
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 15,
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                ZIndex = 9
            })
            ServerLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Text")
            ServerLabel:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", "Servidor")
            ServerLabel:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", "Server")

            local Grid = createStatGrid(Card)
            local _, playersVal = createStatTile(Grid, "Jugadores", "Players")
            local _, maxVal = createStatTile(Grid, "Máximo de jugadores", "Max players")
            local _, pingVal = createStatTile(Grid, "Latencia", "Latency")
            local _, idVal = createStatTile(Grid, "ID del servidor", "Server ID")
            local joinTile, joinVal = createStatTile(Grid, "Script de unión", "Join script")
            local _, timeVal = createStatTile(Grid, "Tiempo en el servidor", "Server time")

            idVal.Text = (game.JobId ~= "" and game.JobId) or "N/A (Studio)"
            joinVal.Text = GetText("Tocar para copiar", "Tap to copy")

            local JoinClick = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = joinTile,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                ZIndex = 11
            })
            JoinClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                local snippet = string.format(
                    'game:GetService("TeleportService"):TeleportToPlaceInstance(%d, "%s", game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer)',
                    game.PlaceId, game.JobId
                )
                local ok = pcall(function() setclipboard(snippet) end)
                joinVal.Text = ok and GetText("¡Copiado!", "Copied!") or GetText("No disponible", "Not available")
                task.delay(2, function()
                    if joinVal and joinVal.Parent then
                        joinVal.Text = GetText("Tocar para copiar", "Tap to copy")
                    end
                end)
            end)

            local startClock = os.clock()
            local StatsService = game:GetService("Stats")

            task.spawn(function()
                while Card.Parent do
                    playersVal.Text = tostring(#Players:GetPlayers())
                    maxVal.Text = tostring(Players.MaxPlayers)

                    local ok, ping = pcall(function()
                        return StatsService.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
                    end)
                    pingVal.Text = (ok and ping) and (math.floor(ping) .. " ms") or "N/A"

                    timeVal.Text = formatDuration(os.clock() - startClock)
                    task.wait(1)
                end
            end)

            resetScrollTop(TabPage)
            return Card
        end

        return Tab
    end

    local textEffectConnection = nil
    Window.CurrentTextEffect = "Off"

    -- v15: la lista de textos se guarda y solo se rehace cuando aparece/desaparece un texto (antes se recorría todo
    -- Main en cada frame con los efectos de texto). El chat global queda afuera: tiene sus propios colores.
    local TextObjs = { dirty = true, list = nil }
    function TextObjs.isText(o)
        return o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox")
    end
    function TextObjs.mark(o)
        if TextObjs.dirty or not TextObjs.isText(o) then return end
        local iso = Window and Window._ThemeIsolatedRoot
        if iso and o:IsDescendantOf(iso) then return end
        TextObjs.dirty = true
    end
    track(Main.DescendantAdded:Connect(TextObjs.mark))
    track(Main.DescendantRemoving:Connect(TextObjs.mark))
    Window._InvalidateTextObjects = function() TextObjs.dirty = true end
    -- v16: lista de Main sin el chat global. GetDescendants devuelve cada rama seguida, así que al encontrar el chat
    -- se saltean sus objetos con un solo chequeo cada uno (si el orden fuera otro, solo se revisaría de más: no rompe)
    function TextObjs.mainList()
        local iso = Window and Window._ThemeIsolatedRoot
        local all = Main:GetDescendants()
        if not iso then return all end
        local out, skipping = {}, false
        for _, obj in ipairs(all) do
            if obj == iso then
                skipping = true
            elseif not (skipping and obj:IsDescendantOf(iso)) then
                skipping = false
                out[#out + 1] = obj
            end
        end
        return out
    end
    local function getAllTextObjects()
        if TextObjs.dirty or not TextObjs.list then
            local list = {}
            local iso = Window and Window._ThemeIsolatedRoot
            for _, obj in ipairs(TextObjs.mainList()) do
                if TextObjs.isText(obj) and not (iso and obj:IsDescendantOf(iso)) then -- chequeo estricto: el chat nunca recibe colores
                    list[#list + 1] = obj
                end
            end
            TextObjs.list, TextObjs.dirty = list, false
        end
        return TextObjs.list
    end

    local function applyTextColorToAll(color)
        for _, obj in ipairs(getAllTextObjects()) do
            if not obj:GetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect") then
                pcall(function()
                    obj.TextColor3 = color
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    local function stopTextEffect()
        if textEffectConnection then
            textEffectConnection:Disconnect()
            textEffectConnection = nil
        end
    end


    function Window:SetTheme(themeName)
        if themeName == "Dark" then
            warn("Tema bloqueado: Dark (Halloween)")
            return
        end
        local BackgroundVideo = self.BackgroundVideo
        if not setActiveTheme(themeName) then
            warn("Tema no encontrado: " .. tostring(themeName))
            return
        end
        
        self.CurrentTheme = themeName
        CurrentTheme = themeName

        -- Se aplica al inicio y protegido: un error en pasos posteriores no lo puede cortar.
        local spriteOk, spriteErr = pcall(applyThemeSprite, self, BackgroundArt, ThemeSprites[themeName])
        if not spriteOk then
            warn("[YinYang Sprite] Error al aplicar el sprite del tema: " .. tostring(spriteErr))
        end

        for _, obj in ipairs(TextObjs.mainList()) do -- v16: sin recorrer el chat global
            swapThemeColor(obj, Theme)
        end

        for _, floatData in ipairs(self.FloatingToggles or {}) do
            local fw = floatData.Window
            if fw and fw.Parent then
                for _, obj in ipairs(fw:GetDescendants()) do
                    swapThemeColor(obj, Theme)
                end
                swapThemeColor(fw, Theme)
                if floatData.RefreshVisual then
                    pcall(floatData.RefreshVisual)
                end
            end
        end
        -- ventanas del script hechas con el kit (YinYang.Kit)
        if YinYang.Kit and YinYang.Kit._Repaint then pcall(YinYang.Kit._Repaint, Theme) end

        applyTextColorToAll(Theme.Text)
        if self._RefreshCompactNavigation then self._RefreshCompactNavigation() end
        for _, t in pairs(self.Tabs or {}) do
            if t.Page and t.Page.Visible and t.Button then
                t.Button.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.TabActive
                t.Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            end
        end

        applyThemeExtras()
        if self._ApplyFullBackground then self._ApplyFullBackground() end
        local themedTabIcons = ThemeTabIcons[themeName]
        local tabIconSize = math.clamp(tonumber((Theme.IconSizes or {}).Tab) or 24, 12, 32)
        for _, t in pairs(self.Tabs or {}) do
            local newIcon = nil
            if themedTabIcons then
                newIcon = themedTabIcons[t.NameEnglish] or themedTabIcons[t.NameSpanish]
            end
            t.IconAsset = newIcon or t.DefaultIconAsset
            if t.IconLabel then
                t.IconLabel.Image = t.IconAsset or ""
                t.IconLabel.ImageColor3 = Theme.TabIcon or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                if themeName ~= "Navidad" then YinIcons.apply(t.IconLabel, YinIcons.tabs[t.NameEnglish] or YinIcons.tabs[t.NameSpanish]) end
                t.IconLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, tabIconSize, 0, tabIconSize)
                t.IconLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0.5, -(tabIconSize / 2))
                if t.NameLabel then
                    t.NameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14 + tabIconSize, 0, 0)
                    t.NameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(24 + tabIconSize), 1, 0)
                end
            end
            if t.CompactButton then
                local compactIcon = t.CompactButton:FindFirstChild("Icon")
                if compactIcon then
                    compactIcon.Image = t.IconAsset or ""
                    compactIcon.ImageColor3 = Theme.TabIcon or Theme.Text
                    if themeName ~= "Navidad" then YinIcons.apply(compactIcon, YinIcons.tabs[t.NameEnglish] or YinIcons.tabs[t.NameSpanish]) end
                end
            end
        end

        self._slideshowToken = (self._slideshowToken or 0) + 1
        self._videoToken = (self._videoToken or 0) + 1
        local mediaToken = self._videoToken
        self._videoFailureCache = self._videoFailureCache or {}

        if self._videoConnection then
            pcall(function() self._videoConnection:Disconnect() end)
            self._videoConnection = nil
        end

        if BackgroundVideo then
            pcall(function()
                BackgroundVideo:Pause()
                BackgroundVideo.Playing = false
                BackgroundVideo.Visible = false
                BackgroundVideo.Video = ""
            end)
        end
        if self._RefreshTabIconLayout then
            self._RefreshTabIconLayout()
        end

        if BackgroundArt then
            BackgroundArt.Visible = true
        end

        if BackgroundArt then
            pcall(function()
                local themeData = ThemeStore and ThemeStore.Themes and ThemeStore.Themes[themeName]
                local videoData = ThemeBackgroundVideos[themeName]
                if themeData and themeData.Video and themeData.Video ~= "" then
                    local rawVideoId = tostring(themeData.Video):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
                    local numericVideoId = rawVideoId and rawVideoId:match("(%d+)")
                    local normalizedVideoId = numericVideoId and ("rbxassetid://" .. numericVideoId) or rawVideoId
                    videoData = {
                        Id = normalizedVideoId,
                        Ids = {normalizedVideoId},
                        Looped = themeData.VideoLooped ~= false,
                        Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(themeData.VideoVolume) or 0, 0, 1),
                    }
                end

                local function applyImages()
                    if not BackgroundArt or not BackgroundArt.Parent then return end
                    BackgroundArt.Visible = true
                    if self._themeSprite then return end
                    if not (themeData and themeData.Images and #themeData.Images > 1) then
                        BackgroundArt.Image = (themeData and themeData.Background) or ThemeBackgroundImages[themeName] or ""
                        return
                    end

                    local token = self._slideshowToken
                    local images = themeData.Images
                    local interval = tonumber(themeData.ImageInterval) or 5
                    BackgroundArt.Image = images[1]
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local i = 1
                        while self._slideshowToken == token and self._videoToken == mediaToken do
                            task.wait(interval)
                            if self._slideshowToken ~= token or self._videoToken ~= mediaToken then break end
                            i = (i % #images) + 1
                            if BackgroundArt and BackgroundArt.Parent and BackgroundArt.Visible then
                                BackgroundArt.Image = images[i]
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end

                if videoData and videoData.Id and BackgroundVideo then
                    local candidates = videoData.Ids or {videoData.Id}
                    local candidateIndex = 1
                    local activated = false
                    local finished = false

                    local function markFailure(videoId)
                        self._videoFailureCache[videoId] = true
                    end

                    local function activateVideo()
                        if activated or self._videoToken ~= mediaToken then return end
                        activated = true
                        finished = true
                        BackgroundArt.Visible = false
                        BackgroundVideo.Visible = true
                        if not PerfOpt.Flags.StaticBackground then
                            pcall(function() BackgroundVideo:Play() end)
                        end
                        print("Video de fondo reproduciendo: " .. tostring(BackgroundVideo.Video))
                    end

                    local function tryNextVideo()
                        if activated or finished or self._videoToken ~= mediaToken then return end
                        while candidateIndex <= #candidates and self._videoFailureCache[candidates[candidateIndex]] do
                            candidateIndex = candidateIndex + 1
                        end
                        if candidateIndex > #candidates then
                            finished = true
                            BackgroundVideo.Visible = false
                            BackgroundArt.Visible = true
                            print("Videos de J1 no disponibles; se mantiene el fondo de imagen")
                            return
                        end

                        local videoId = candidates[candidateIndex]
                        candidateIndex = candidateIndex + 1
                        local loaded = false
                        pcall(function()
                            BackgroundVideo:Pause()
                            BackgroundVideo.Playing = false
                            BackgroundVideo.Visible = false
                            BackgroundVideo.Looped = videoData.Looped ~= false
                            BackgroundVideo.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(videoData.Volume) or 0, 0, 1)
                            BackgroundVideo.Video = videoId
                            self._videoConnection = BackgroundVideo.Loaded:Connect(function()
                                loaded = true
                                activateVideo()
                            end)
                        end)
                        print("Video de fondo solicitado: " .. tostring(videoId))

                        task.spawn(function()
                            local deadline = tick() + 6
                            while self._videoToken == mediaToken and BackgroundVideo.Parent and not loaded and not BackgroundVideo.IsLoaded and tick() < deadline do
                                task.wait(0.15)
                            end
                            if self._videoToken ~= mediaToken or activated then return end
                            if BackgroundVideo.IsLoaded then
                                activateVideo()
                            else
                                markFailure(videoId)
                                if self._videoConnection then
                                    pcall(function() self._videoConnection:Disconnect() end)
                                    self._videoConnection = nil
                                end
                                tryNextVideo()
                            end
                        end)
                    end

                    tryNextVideo()
                else
                    applyImages()
                    print("Imagen de fondo actualizada")
                end
            end)
        end

        SavedConfig.CurrentTheme = themeName
        SaveConfig()

        local themeData = ThemeStore and ThemeStore.Themes and ThemeStore.Themes[themeName]
        if themeData and themeData.Sound then
            CurrentClickSound = themeData.Sound
        elseif ThemeClickSounds[themeName] then
            CurrentClickSound = ThemeClickSounds[themeName]
            print("Tema " .. themeName .. " - Sonido de click personalizado activado")
        else
            CurrentClickSound = Sounds.Click
        end

        local autoEffect = (themeData and themeData.Effect) or ThemeAutoEffects[themeName]
        if autoEffect and autoEffect ~= "Off" then
            self:SetTextEffect(autoEffect)
        else
            self:SetTextEffect("Off")
        end

        if TopBarArt then
            pcall(function()
                local img = (themeData and themeData.TitleBarImage) or ThemeTitleBarImages[themeName] or ""
                TopBarArt.Image = img
            end)
        end

        if TabListArt then
            pcall(function()
                local img = (themeData and themeData.TabListImage) or ThemeTabListImages[themeName] or ""
                TabListArt.Image = img
                TabList.BackgroundTransparency = Theme.TransparentTabs and 1 or (img ~= "" and 0.5 or 0)
            end)
        end

        CurrentTheme = themeName

        buildAnimatedBorder(Main, Theme.Border, UDim.new(0, 10))

        for _, floatData in ipairs(Window.FloatingToggles or {}) do
            if floatData.Window and floatData.Window.Parent and not floatData.Window:GetAttribute("YYPillV5") then
                buildAnimatedBorder(floatData.Window, Theme.Border, UDim.new(1, 0), true)
            end
        end

        for _, obj in ipairs(TextObjs.mainList()) do -- v16: sin recorrer el chat global
            if obj:GetAttribute("IsSliderHolder") then
                buildAnimatedBorder(obj, Theme.Border, UDim.new(0, 12), true)
            end
        end

        if self._refreshEffectRows then
            self._refreshEffectRows()
        end
        if self._refreshShaderCustomTheme then
            self._refreshShaderCustomTheme()
        end
    end

    function Window:SetTextEffect(mode)
        stopTextEffect()
        Window.CurrentTextEffect = mode
        SavedConfig.CurrentEffect = mode
        SaveConfig()
        -- Optimización: el efecto elegido queda guardado, pero no corre su loop
        if PerfOpt.Flags.NoTextEffects then mode = "Off" end

        if mode == "Off" then
            for _, obj in ipairs(getAllTextObjects()) do
                local role = obj:GetAttribute("ThemeTextRole")
                if role and Theme[role] then
                    obj.TextColor3 = Theme[role]
                elseif not role then
                    obj.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
                end
            end
            return
        end

        local elapsed = 0
        local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

        if mode == "WhiteCyan" then
            local colorA = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            local colorB = Color3.fromRGB(120, 225, 255)
            textEffectConnection = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                local alpha = (math.sin(elapsed * 1.6) + 1) / 2
                applyTextColorToAll(colorA:Lerp(colorB, alpha))
            end))

        elseif mode == "WhitePink" then
            local colorA = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            local colorB = Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 205)
            textEffectConnection = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                local alpha = (math.sin(elapsed * 0.6) + 1) / 2
                applyTextColorToAll(colorA:Lerp(colorB, alpha))
            end))

        elseif mode == "Rainbow" then
            textEffectConnection = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                local hue = (elapsed * 0.12) % 1
                applyTextColorToAll(Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.85, 1))
            end))

        elseif mode == "CatRainbow" then
            textEffectConnection = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                local cycle = (elapsed * 5) % 1
                
                local color
                if cycle < 0.5 then
                    local t = cycle * 2
                    color = Color3.fromRGB(
                        255,
                        math.floor(100 + (255 - 100) * t),
                        math.floor(150 + (255 - 150) * t)
                    )
                else
                    local t = (cycle - 0.5) * 2
                    color = Color3.fromRGB(
                        255,
                        math.floor(255 - (255 - 100) * t),
                        math.floor(255 - (255 - 150) * t)
                    )
                end
                
                applyTextColorToAll(color)
            end))

        elseif mode == "RainbowDarkWhite" then
            textEffectConnection = track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                local cycle = (elapsed * 0.25) % 1
                
                local
